summary: Frontend retest of the iteration_5 failures on mobile 390x844, plus a regression check of the Agenda flyer. Seeded a client, an OS and an agenda via the API; all deleted afterwards. PASS (1) Overflow: Orçamento with 5 filled items (flyer-item-add hides at 5) and outros capped at 3 lines (a 4th line is dropped). Total is at 594-630, Validade/Pagamento at 653-679, footer top at 697. All of it is visible live and in the PNG. Recibo with 3 obs lines: the signature (656-675) and technician name (675-688) sit above the footer (697), and the PNG shows the signature, the 'Marcos Vinícius' name and the 3 obs lines with commas and descenders intact. PASS (2) num(): '1.250' gives 'mil duzentos e cinquenta reais' and '2.000.000' gives 'dois milhões de reais'. 'R$ 1.250,50' is correct. Orçamento total: 120 + 45 + '1.250' + '10,5' + 99,90 + outros 'R$ 35,00' + 'R$ 1.200' = R$ 2.760,40, which is correct. PASS (3) The orçamento WhatsApp text formats items as R$ 120,00, R$ 45,00, R$ 1.250,00, R$ 10,50 and R$ 99,90. PASS (4) The garantia placeholder is 'ex.: 90'. The PNG shows 'R$ 1.250,00' when '1.250' is typed, and '90 dias'. REGRESSION PASS: agenda-flyer-{id} from the Agenda list view and wa-sheet-send-flyer both open 'Flyer de Agendamento' with the footer visible and the download working. Six short obs lines fit exactly (scrollHeight 116 = clientHeight 116). No page errors. REMAINING ISSUES: the PNG total-bar value still sits low; long lines that wrap overflow the 'lines-capped' text boxes; minor alignment of the date-line values.

ui_bugs.issue: maxLines counts logical '\n' lines, not wrapped visual lines. Long lines wrap and overflow the fixed-height box, so the last lines are clipped live and in the PNG. Examples: Recibo obs with a long first line plus 2 more lines (scrollHeight 82 > clientHeight 65). Agenda: the default OBS_PADRAO already wraps to 2 visual lines, so an agenda with default plus 5 more lines (6 logical lines) loses the 6th line ('linha6' is missing in the PNG). Fix: check scrollHeight > clientHeight in onChange and reject or trim the input, or lower the cap / shorten OBS_PADRAO.

issues: The value 'R$ 2.760,40' is still not vertically centered in the html2canvas PNG. Measured at 3x: bar 1629-1748 (center 1688), digits about 1684-1734 (center about 1709), so it is about 7px low at 1x. The 'TOTAL' label is fine (about 2px off). The onclone top:-5px applies equally to both spans; the value span needs a larger offset (about -12px) or a separate rule.
Minor: the filled values '28', 'outubro' and '26' still sit a few px above the baseline of 'Bicas, MG ... de ... de 20'.
Minor: the valor is sent raw as typed ('*1.250*'), while the PNG shows 'R$ 1.250,00'. Use fmtBRL(num(f.valor)) as the orçamento does.

action_items: Make the Texto line cap account for wrapped lines (scrollHeight check), or the agenda default obs plus 5 lines and long recibo/outros lines get clipped
Adjust the onclone offset for the total value span (Barlow 24px) so it is centered in the PNG bar
Optional: format the recibo valor in the WhatsApp text; nudge the date-line values in the PNG
critical_code_review_comments: The fixed 720px canvas with overflow hidden still relies on logical line caps; a generic overflow guard (compare body scrollHeight to clientHeight and warn) would prevent silent clipping.
Note: proxAg only selects future agendamentos (data >= hoje). The env date is 2026-10-28, so past seeds open an empty agenda flyer from the WA sheet. This is expected.
